facts.text: Christmas dinner at the shelter where Tom volunteers, and Kate finally pitches in
facts.why: Kate helps at the shelter and organises a Christmas Eve show there. The plot has Christmas Day with her family, not a Christmas dinner at the shelter.
facts.fix: Christmas Eve at the shelter, where Kate finally pitches in
